integrity: The structural proof is analytic, using previously published reachability and monotonicity bounds together with an explicit obstruction; the five-vertex census is exhaustive with two distinct cycle detectors, but finite tests are not a substitute for the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: The graph family is restricted to the join of an independent two-vertex set and a matching-plus-isolates; profile enumeration covers only the minimal five-vertex obstruction with three named colours. Historical priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit was performed.
title: A matching-edge jump and exact preference obstructions in stable graph colouring
